Compute every site's occupancy in every run, with mzLib's SiteOccupancyCalculator

ptmqtl_occupancy.Rd

Intensity-based occupancy of every modification site in every run (or sample), from a table of MS/MS-identified peptidoforms with their per-run intensities, with the censoring state of each cell.

For a site (protein, position, modification) in a run, occupancy is the summed intensity of the quantified peptidoforms that carry the modification there, over the summed intensity of every quantified peptidoform that covers the position - the estimator MetaMorpheus writes as IntensityOccupancy_. Each cell keeps its state, so a censored cell is never mistaken for a 0: a "floor" (the modified form was identified but not quantified) is low but not zero, and "not_detected" (peptidoforms covering the site were identified in the run, quantified or not, and none carried the modification; mzLib #1468) is a bound below what the run could detect. Neither has a fraction.

Usage

ptmqtl_occupancy(observations, samples = NULL, modifications = NULL, categories = NULL,
  out = NULL, timeout = 600)

Arguments

observations

A TSV with a header row naming its columns, one row per (run, peptidoform, protein) identified by MS/MS: run, full_sequence (MetaMorpheus notation), protein_accession, start_residue and end_residue (1-based, in the protein), intensity (instrument units; blank or NA for identified but not quantified), and optionally previous_residue (one letter). A shared peptide is one row per protein. Never one row per PSM, and never a match-between-runs transfer. mzLib has no reader that builds this table; the ptmqtl article shows how to assemble it.

samples

A TSV with a header row, then run, sample, to sum each sample's fractions before the ratio; the run column of the result then holds the sample. Map only fractions together, never technical replicates. Leave it NULL for per-run occupancy.

modifications

Count only these modifications as sites: exact names, Category:IdWithMotif, as a character vector. Not with categories. NULL: no filter.

categories

Count only modifications of these categories (the text before the first :), as a character vector, e.g. "Common Biological". Not with modifications.

out

Write the table to this .tsv instead of returning it - the file ptmqtl_trait_effects reads. Then records has no rows and written says where.

timeout

Seconds to allow, or NULL to wait indefinitely.

Details

mzLib always leaves out the categories Common Variable and Common Fixed, peptide-terminal modifications and every C-terminal modification. An N-terminal modification is a site only on a peptide that starts at residue 1, or at 2 after the initiator Met is removed.

Value

An mzlibr_site_occupancy:

- records, a data.frame with one row per (site, run) where the site was identified or covered, by protein, then run, then position and modification: site_key, accession:residue position:modification, the key ptmqtl_pairs and ptmqtl_trait_effects use; protein_accession; position, the 1-based residue (a protein N-terminal modification at the residue it sits on); residue; modification, Category:IdWithMotif; category, the text before the first :; run, the run or with samples the sample; state, one of "quantified", "floor", "count_only" or "not_detected"; modified_intensity (intensity, instrument units), the summed intensity of the quantified forms carrying the modification here, 0 unless quantified; covering_intensity (intensity, instrument units), of every quantified form covering the position, 0 for "count_only"; fraction (fraction, 0 to 1), modified over covering intensity, NA unless state is "quantified" - censored, never 0; unmodified_quantified, where FALSE with fraction 1 is a ceiling: the site was seen only modified; and the peptidoform counts (mzLib #1468), which count identifications, not intensity: covering_peptidoforms (peptidoforms), the distinct peptidoforms covering the position identified in the run, quantified or not - the n of a cell's k of n - and modified_peptidoforms (peptidoforms), those of them carrying this modification here - the k, 0 for "not_detected". Both are NA only from a table that did not supply them; mzLib's calculation always does. - observations_file and samples_file (NA without samples), as absolute paths; observation_count rows read; run_count runs; sample_count samples, NA without samples; run_names; site_count sites; state_counts, cells per state; modifications and categories, the filter given, NULL for none; ignored_columns, columns that were not read (a misspelled previous_residue shows up here); row_count rows, returned or written; column_names; written (path, format, row_count), or NULL. - caveats: what the numbers are and are not, plus any that apply to this input.

Positions

position is 1-based, unlike readers_read_occupancy, whose N-terminus is 0. A peptide shared by several proteins counts in full for each; MetaMorpheus gives it a proportional share per protein group, so its IntensityOccupancy_ can differ.

Wraps

Wire verb ptmqtl occupancy. Generated from the bridge's verb spec ptmqtl.occupancy.yaml (bridge commit 4e180efe8b59) by scripts/build-man.R; the spec owns these facts, and all three bindings render the same ones.

  • PeptidoformObservation in mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs at mzLib d10017ce

  • SiteRunOccupancy in mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs at mzLib cc67b7a2

  • ModificationSite in mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs at mzLib d10017ce

  • OccupancyState in mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs at mzLib d10017ce

Parameters: units, ranges and defaults

observations

path; required. A TSV with a header row naming its columns, in any order, one row per (run, peptidoform, protein) identified by MS/MS: run; full_sequence, the peptidoform in MetaMorpheus notation (a modification as [Category:IdWithMotif] after its residue, a protein N-terminal one before the first residue); protein_accession; start_residue and end_residue, the peptide's first and last residue in the protein, 1-based; intensity, the peptidoform's MS/MS-quantified intensity in that run in instrument units (blank, NA or NaN means identified but not quantified); and optionally previous_residue, the protein residue before the peptide (one letter, blank when unknown). A peptide shared by several proteins is one row per protein. One row per PSM is refused, since it would count an intensity several times. A match-between-runs transfer must not be a row. A 0 intensity is read as quantified at zero, and adds nothing to either sum. Any other column is not read and is listed in ignored_columns. mzLib has no reader that builds this table from MetaMorpheus or FlashLFQ output; the pyMzLib ptmqtl guide shows how.

samples

path; default absent. Optional. A TSV with a header row, then run, sample: two columns, one row per run. With it, each peptidoform's intensity is summed over a sample's runs before the ratio (mzLib's runToSample overload), and the run column of the result holds the sample. Every run of the observations must be listed; a run listed here but absent there is ignored, as mzLib ignores it. Map only fractions of one sample together, never technical replicates. Absent, the bridge sends none and occupancy is per run.

modifications

string; default absent; range exact names, tab-separated, none blank. Optional. Count only these modifications as sites: exact names as full_sequence writes them, Category:IdWithMotif, separated by tabs (a name holds spaces and commas, never a tab). mzLib's includeModification filter, applied after its own exclusions. Not with categories. Absent, the bridge sends no filter: every modification mzLib does not exclude is a site.

categories

string; default absent; range category names, tab-separated, none blank. Optional. Count only modifications of these categories, the text before the first ':' of the name (mzLib's ModificationSite.Category), for example Common Biological. Separated by tabs. Not with modifications. Absent, no filter.

out

path; default absent; range .tsv only, any case (PYB-1). Write the table to this path as plain tab-separated text instead of returning columns: one header row (column_names), null as an empty cell, numbers in invariant culture at round-trip precision, booleans as true or false, nothing quoted. This is the file ptmqtl trait-effects reads as occupancy. Parent directories are created. Must differ from observations. Must end in .tsv, any case; any other extension, or none, is a usage error before any input is read.

Returned fields

Each field with its type, its unit, and what NA means when it is NA.

observations_file

string; never NA. Absolute path of the observations table.

samples_file

string; NA when no --samples: occupancy is per run. Absolute path of the run-to-sample table.

observation_count

int; in rows; never NA. Observation rows read.

run_count

int; in runs; never NA. Distinct runs in the observations.

sample_count

int; in samples; NA when no --samples. Distinct samples in the run-to-sample table.

run_names

string[]; never NA. The distinct values of the run column, in ordinal order: the runs, or with --samples the samples, that have at least one cell.

site_count

int; in sites; never NA. Distinct sites (protein, position, modification) in the table.

state_counts

map<string,int>; in cells; never NA. Cells per state: quantified, floor, count_only, not_detected.

modifications

string[]; NA when no --modifications filter. The modification names the sites were limited to.

categories

string[]; NA when no --categories filter. The categories the sites were limited to.

ignored_columns

string[]; never NA. Columns of the observations file that are not fields of mzLib's observation, so were not read; empty when every column was read.

row_count

int; in rows; never NA. Cells in the table, whether returned or written.

column_names

string[]; never NA. The table's columns, in order; also the header --out writes.

records (wire columns)

table; NA when the table was written to --out instead. One row per (site, run) where the site was identified or covered, in mzLib's order: by protein, then run, then position and modification.

written

object; NA when --out was not given. {path, format: tsv, row_count} of the file --out wrote.

caveats

string[]; never NA. Seven static caveats; one more with --samples, one when columns were not read, and one counting the censored (floor or not_detected) cells when there are any.

Columns of records

site_key

string; never NA. mzLib's ModificationSite.Key, accession:residue position:modification, for example P1:S13:Common Biological:Phosphorylation on S. The key ptmqtl pairs and ptmqtl trait-effects name sites by.

protein_accession

string; never NA. The protein the site is on, as given.

position

int; never NA. 1-based residue position in the protein. A protein N-terminal modification is at the residue it sits on (1, or 2 after the initiator Met is removed). readers read-occupancy counts differently (0 is the N-terminus): do not join the two on position.

residue

string; never NA. The one-letter residue at position.

modification

string; never NA. The modification as full_sequence names it, Category:IdWithMotif.

category

string; never NA. The text before the first ':' of modification (mzLib's ModificationSite.Category); empty when the name has none.

run

string; never NA. The run, or with --samples the sample.

state

string; never NA. quantified (the modified form was quantified: a fraction in (0, 1]) | floor (the modified form was identified but not quantified while forms covering the site were: low but NOT zero) | count_only (the modified form was identified, but nothing covering the site was quantified) | not_detected (a covered-zero, mzLib's DEF-OCC-COVERED-ZERO: peptidoforms covering the site were identified in this run and none carried the modification; a bound below what the run could detect, not a measured 0; since mzLib #1468 the covering forms need not be quantified).

modified_intensity

float; in intensity (instrument units); never NA. Summed intensity of the quantified peptidoforms carrying this modification at this position; 0 unless state is quantified.

covering_intensity

float; in intensity (instrument units); never NA. Summed intensity of every quantified peptidoform covering the position, modified or not; 0 for count_only.

fraction

float; in fraction (0 to 1); NA when state is not quantified: the occupancy is censored (floor), a bound (not_detected) or unknown (count_only), never 0. modified_intensity / covering_intensity.

unmodified_quantified

bool; never NA. Whether some quantified form covering the position does not carry this modification there (the unmodified form, or another modification at the same position). false with fraction 1 is a ceiling: the site was seen only modified.

covering_peptidoforms

int; in peptidoforms; NA when not supplied (Calculate always supplies it; a stored table may not). Distinct peptidoforms covering the position identified in this run (or sample), quantified or not: mzLib's SiteRunOccupancy.CoveringPeptidoforms (#1468). It counts identifications, not intensity: the n of a cell's k of n.

modified_peptidoforms

int; in peptidoforms; NA when not supplied, as covering_peptidoforms. Of covering_peptidoforms, those carrying this modification at the position (SiteRunOccupancy.ModifiedPeptidoforms): the k. 0 for not_detected. A count_only cell with k = n was seen only modified; with k < n both forms were identified.

Errors

Each is an R condition carrying the class shown and mzlib_error; see mzlib_error.

mzlib_usage_error (usage)

observations missing, blank or not found; samples given without a value or not found; out given without a value, not ending in .tsv, or the observations path; modifications and categories both given, either without a value or with a blank name

mzlib_usage_error (usage)

the observations file empty, header-only, missing a required column, with a repeated column name, a row whose field count differs from its header, a start_residue or end_residue that is not an integer, an intensity that is not a number (other than blank, NA, NaN), or a previous_residue longer than one letter; the samples file without two fields per row, with a blank or repeated run

mzlib_usage_error (usage)

mzLib refuses the observations, in its own words: an empty run, sequence or accession; start_residue below 1 or a span that does not fit the sequence's length; an infinite or negative intensity; one (run, peptidoform, protein, start) given twice; a run with no sample, or an empty sample

mzlib_bridge_error (correctness)

never expected

mzlib_service_unavailable (service_unavailable)

Never raised by this verb.

Caveats

  • Intensity occupancy, as MetaMorpheus writes IntensityOccupancy_ (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT): for a site in a run, the summed intensity of the quantified peptidoforms carrying the modification at that position over the summed intensity of every quantified peptidoform covering it. Supply MS/MS identifications only: a match-between-runs transfer must not be a row.

  • fraction is null unless state is quantified. A floor (identified, not quantified, while the site was covered) is low but not zero, and not_detected is a bound below detection: neither may be averaged in as 0.

  • A fraction of 1 with unmodified_quantified false is a ceiling: the unmodified form may be present below detection.

  • position is 1-based, with a protein N-terminal modification at the residue it sits on; readers read-occupancy puts the N-terminus at 0.

  • mzLib always excludes the categories Common Variable and Common Fixed, peptide-terminal modifications, and every C-terminal modification (the protein's length is not supplied). An N-terminal modification is a site only on a peptide starting at residue 1, or at 2 when previous_residue is M or blank. Whether it is protein- or peptide-terminal is read from mzLib's modification registry; a name the registry does not know is treated as protein N-terminal.

  • A peptide shared by several proteins counts in full for each; MetaMorpheus gives it a proportional share per protein group, so its IntensityOccupancy_ can differ.

  • With samples, fractions are summed before the ratio. Map only fractions of one sample together; technical replicates keep their own run.

  • covering_peptidoforms and modified_peptidoforms count identifications, not intensity: the k of n of a cell with no fraction. They tell a count_only cell seen only modified from one where both forms were identified, which is what ptmqtl pairs --include-bounds ranks as a high bound or leaves out.

Performance

Every call starts one bridge process, which costs a .NET start-up before any work.

Examples


# mzLib's own hand-computed cases, one protein each:
cases <- system.file("extdata", "ptmqtl", "cases.tsv", package = "mzLibR")
occ <- ptmqtl_occupancy(cases)
occ
#> <mzlibr_site_occupancy> 9 sites in 6 runs, 14 cells
#>   quantified 9, floor 1, count_only 3, not_detected 1
occ$records[occ$records$protein_accession == "STATES", c("run", "state", "fraction")]
#>           run        state fraction
#> 6   countOnly   count_only       NA
#> 7       floor        floor       NA
#> 8 notDetected not_detected       NA
#> 9       quant   quantified      0.1
# RATIO is 30 / (30 + 70 + 100): a missed-cleavage form covering the site counts below the line.
occ$records[occ$records$protein_accession == "RATIO", c("modification", "fraction")]
#>                             modification fraction
#> 3 Common Biological:Phosphorylation on S     0.15
